description: Structured (L0 operator) agent with an output schema, then invoked — schema-validated fields out.

turns.user: 创建一个结构化抽取 agent,名为「风险判定」:按需运行,提示词「判断电量风险」,输出 schema:risk 字段为枚举 [low, high],score 字段为数字。
调用它评估 sensor-001 的电量,把结构化结果给我看。

per_turn: T1: `neomind agent create` --execution-mode structured,--output-schema 定义 risk(枚举 low/high)与 score(数字)
T2: 用 `neomind agent invoke` 运行
expectations.overall: Agent stored as structured mode with schema; at least one execution recorded
